title: Applicable Dyes
description: Allows direct block dyeing by shift right-clicking a dyeable block.
body:
**Applicable Dyes** is a server-sided mod for allowing players to directly apply dyes to dyeable blocks.

### Shift Dyeing:
Allows players to dye blocks only shifting. If it's turned off in the config file, then shifting restricts you from dyeing blocks instead.

### Solid Block Dyeing:
Allows players to dye solid blocks, e.g. Concrete, Terracotta, Glass Blocks & Panes & Glazed Terracotta. This can also be changed in the config file.
